lede: I design the architecture of attention.
bio1: As a multidisciplinary Creative Director with over nine years of experience, I specialize in turning high-level concepts into immersive, high-fidelity visual narratives. The sweet spot? Where bold art direction meets technical evolution.
bio2: We live in a world of digital static. To cut through it, I don't just follow trends. As an early adopter of generative AI, leveraging the most recent tools. I build workflows that move at the speed of Tech, without losing the human soul of the work. The tools change every month; the creative discipline doesn't.
bio3: From conceptualizing tech-forward stage environments for global players like TikTok and Microsoft, to developing video hooks that capture absolute focus, I create physical and digital experiences that leave a mark.
bio4: Concepts that cut through. Built with discipline, not decoration. If it isn't innovative, immersive, and a step ahead, it isn't on the radar.
